adds.rationale: Fresh NYSE debut of a national-security space and space-infrastructure company (Starlab, the planned ISS successor) gives the watchlist distinct exposure to orbital infrastructure and defense-space convergence, complementing RKLB's launch-vehicle exposure and ASTS's satellite-to-phone network rather than duplicating either.

news_evidence.summary: Voyager Technologies begins trading on NYSE under ticker VOYG at a $3.8B IPO valuation on debut

Voyager restructured into three segments (Defense & National Security, Space Solutions, Starlab Space Stations); ~50% of revenue from national-security customers; Starlab is a LEO commercial space station JV with Airbus targeting launch before ISS decommissioning

removes.rationale: BOTZ's basket is a broad, generic industrial-automation/AI wrapper whose top holdings already duplicate NVDA and ISRG that we hold directly, so it adds thematic overlap rather than distinct robotics signal; a purer humanoid-robotics vehicle (KraneShares KOID) just entered the market and is a better watch for next rebalance, freeing this slot for the sharper VOYG space-infrastructure thesis now.

news_evidence.summary: NVIDIA and Intuitive Surgical are among BOTZ's top-5 holdings, both already held directly in the watchlist, reducing BOTZ's incremental diversification value
KraneShares launched the first US-listed pure-play humanoid robotics/embodied-AI ETF (KOID) on Nasdaq, giving the robotics wave a more targeted vehicle than BOTZ's broad mandate

rationale_overall: One clean, well-evidenced swap this quarter: drop the generic BOTZ robotics/AI basket (redundant with directly-held NVDA and ISRG) for VOYG, a fresh NYSE listing that adds space-station/national-security-space infrastructure exposure distinct from RKLB (launch) and ASTS (satellite comms), serving the thesis's #1 next wave. Existing positions all checked out: RKLB (Motiv Space Systems robotics acquisition, ~$8B Iridium deal announced late June), LEU (completed its 900kg HALEU delivery milestone to DOE and secured a Phase III extension), IONQ (SkyWater acquisition, SHIELD IDIQ selection), CTRE (Care REIT UK acquisition closed, dividend raised), ASTS (Q1 business update confirming deployment cadence), and LMT/ITA (large THAAD production award, continued defense-budget tailwind) all show fresh momentum. STNG was reviewed for removal on the June 2025 Israel-Iran conflict but the aftermath sources blurred into a later 2026 crisis I could not cleanly separate, so per leakage discipline that remove was dropped. KraneShares KOID and BWXT surfaced as strong candidates but were held back rather than forcing a second removal against the 16-ticker cap. Watchlist stays at cap.
